rationale: Price is sitting near the session low (11% of range), well below VWAP ($14.55) and the 9-EMA ($14.50), in a broad risk-off tape (SPY -1.57%, VIXY +10%), which favors continued downside pressure. However, the last five 1-minute candles show very low volume and choppy, directionless micro-action with no clear momentum in either direction, and the stock is already extended ~6% off its session high with no news catalyst to anchor a thesis. The risk/reward for a short entry this close to the day's low without a clean consolidation-and-breakdown pattern, and for a long against the prevailing trend, is insufficient to justify a new position.
